reason.ZENITH: Wait - the sun is at its zenith.
reason.AFTER_FAJR: After Fajr, voluntary prayer is withheld until the sun has risen.
reason.AFTER_ASR: After Asr, voluntary prayer is withheld until Maghrib.
reason.PERMITTED_GENERIC: It is permissible to pray this now.
warn.TODAYS_ASR: Yes - pray your Asr now, before Maghrib. Delaying it to this time is sinful, but the prayer is valid and obligatory.
warn.FAJR_EXPIRED: Fajr's time has ended. Pray it as qaḍāʾ after the sun has fully risen (≈{minutes} min).
note.FARD_ALWAYS: Pray {prayer} in its time - do not let it pass.
note.FARD_NONE: No obligatory prayer is due now. Pray the next one in its time.
period.NONE: No obligatory prayer time is running
note.SUNNAH_FAJR: The two rakʿahs of Fajr are excepted - pray them before Fajr.
note.JANAZAH_STRICT: A funeral prayer here is disliked if it was ready earlier; permitted if it became ready now.
note.JANAZAH_SOLAR: A funeral prayer in the three sun-times is best delayed a few minutes; pray it here only if there is need.
note.FRIDAY_ZENITH: Friday: the zenith prohibition does not apply (Shāfiʿī).
note.MAKKAH_HARAM: Within the Makkan Ḥaram: no time is prohibited (Shāfiʿī).
highlat.DEGRADED: This far north, prayer-time rulings need local scholarly guidance - the standard windows can't be computed reliably here today.
footer.PROVENANCE: Rulings from the Qurʾān & Sunnah · rule set {version} · Methodology
label.QUESTION: Can I pray now?
now.NONE: No obligatory prayer is due right now
tip.ISHRAQ: Ishrāq - the sun has fully risen; the sunrise prohibition ends here.
tip.ZENITH: Zenith (istiwāʾ) - the sun stands at its highest; prayer is withheld until it passes (zawāl).
tip.ISFIRAR: Isfirār - the sun yellows in its final descent; the last restricted window before Maghrib.
locate.DENIED: Location unavailable - pick your city instead.
locate.DENIED_KEEP: Could not detect your location. Still using {city} - search above to change it.
toast.LOCATION_CHANGED: You appear to be in {city} now - times updated.
toast.TZ_CHANGED_CHECK: Your timezone changed but your location could not be confirmed. Check the city in settings.
tip.SUNRISE_AT: Sunrise at {time} - Fajr's time ends here.

settings.BASIS_NOTE: The default follows the Qurʾān and Sunnah directly, not a school. Choose a school only if you follow one - it also sets the Asr time.

settings.MAKKAH_NOTE: In Shāfiʿī fiqh no time is prohibited within the Ḥaram. Never assumed from GPS - set it yourself.
